summary: Iteration 13 — Full-stack validation of the new inline media assets feature (images + music cues placed inside chapters). Backend endpoints tested via pytest (3/3 pass). Frontend flow validated end-to-end with Playwright: RTE image insertion, RTE music cue insertion (with title + audio upload), persistence after save, reader inline rendering, manual cue playback (data-active toggling), fade replacement (only one cue active at a time), and non-looping playback confirmed via captured audio.loop=false. Coexistence with existing reader-music header + chapter cover + navigation verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~700 lines and mixes 8 resource domains (creations, categories, comments, ambiences, subscribers, settings, intro, assets). Consider splitting into routers/*.py modules for maintainability.

Backend /api/creations/{cid}/assets uploads do NOT verify the creation exists (unlike upload_audio which 404s). A user could upload assets to a non-existent creation id and orphan them. Low priority but worth an explicit 404 check + cascade on delete (already handled).

Frontend RichTextEditor.js currently accepts any file size up to backend limit (12 Mo) without client-side validation feedback; the 413 error message isn't surfaced to the user (uploadAsset promise rejection is only logged).
insertHTML uses document.execCommand which is deprecated. Works today in Chromium/Safari/Firefox but marked legacy — no immediate action needed.
test_credentials: Admin PIN 1234 via localStorage sx_admin=1 + sx_pin=1234. Intro bypass: sx_intro_off=1 + sessionStorage sx_intro_shown=1.
seed_data_creation: Test-only WAV cues (LongA/LongB) and PNG image were inserted into 'Born X Burn' chapter 1 during Playwright test, THEN CLEANED UP: all TEST_/LongA/LongB/CueA/CueB/img.png/Thème Test/Second Test assets deleted via DELETE /api/assets/{id}, and chapter 1 content restored to the original seed text via PUT /api/creations/{cid}. Verified /api/creations/{cid}/assets returns 0 test assets afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inline assets flow works: POST /api/creations/{cid}/assets accepts multipart (file + kind=image|audio + name), returns {id,kind,name,content_type}. GET /assets/{aid} serves bytes with Cache-Control immutable. RichTextEditor emits and . ChapterReader onCueClick calls toggleReadingUrl(url, 'cue:'+url, {loop:false}); effect keyed on [playingId,isPlaying,idx] toggles data-active on cues. IMPORTANT for future tests: use audio files of at least 5s (short clips like 0.5s WAV end quickly and 'ended' listener flips isPlaying back to false BEFORE assertion runs — this looks like a bug but is expected behavior). To confirm loop=false, monkey-patch HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play and inspect this.loop before delegating.
